title: g_tls_safe_mode set-once process-wide; silently disables others' hardware hash
description: Scenario: Library A calls wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(ctx), setting g_tls_safe_mode=1 process-wide. Library B (linked in the same process) uses WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID directly for hardware SHA-256. After Library A's call, Library B's hash ops return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE and silently fall back to software — no error, no diagnostic. Library B cannot detect this happened. The header comment documents this, but library authors rarely read header comments on functions they don't call. Maintenance consequence: support tickets from users who set up hardware hash and then link a TLS library that calls assign_devid, finding their hardware hash mysteriously stopped working. The pattern to fix (register a second devId for bulk-hash) is documented but non-obvious.
